note: The external legs' cost table (scripts/schedule.py pack-external), refreshed by PR from named runs. A tool priced per object (object_min) is cut into object legs of about target_leg_min each, longest object first; every other tool runs as one leg of job_min. Each leg's timeout is max(timeout_floor_min, ceil(timeout_factor x predicted)). A stale table costs balance and timeout margin, never results.

kete.source: MEASURED per object, scaled to the hosted runner: every row kete runs with the sixteen SB441-N16 masses (kete 3.3.0, the run's plan of run 42940569667), timed locally as process CPU with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 and scaled by 0.617, the mean hosted-wall / local-CPU ratio of the three OD fits run 42506609035 timed on the hosted runner (Hygiea, Pallas, Vesta, no masses; ratios 0.51 to 0.69). OD is the whole cost (85.8 of 86.1 local CPU min); the catalog sums to 53.1 min, against the 31-minute single leg run 42940569667 cancelled while fitting. Iris, Vesta, Pallas and Hygiea are named unsupported and never run. setup_min is that run's job start to its Run kete step (66 s); leg_overhead_min covers the kete import and staging (4 s) and the output steps. An object not in the table is priced at the catalog mean, 1.154 min.

oorb.source: ESTIMATED, not measured on a hosted runner: the leg was off until the runner-fixes PR, so no hosted run has timed it. About 50 min is the full catalog's wall on 4 vCPU with the BC430 asteroid perturbers on (rows run as concurrent oorb processes, about 2 s per call); replace it with the first hosted job wall.

layup.source: job wall of run 39726274647, the only full run in which layup completed

jorbit.source: MODELED, not measured per object: no hosted run has completed jorbit over the catalog (it died after 41 to 72 min on runs 42506609035, 40612958887 and 39726274647). Each object is priced at the per-dt propagation times jorbit measured on run 40276519232 (Apophis, jorbit_time_ms: 8.8 to 11.6 s for |dt| <= 365 d, 32.9 to 34.1 s beyond) summed over the object's none-tagged propagation rows in run 42506609035's plan, plus 0.5 s per geocentric ephemeris row; the catalog sums to 205 min. setup_min is the measured Setup step (51 to 71 s); leg_overhead_min covers the import and the geocentre ephemeris.

orbfit.source: orbfit_time_ms per object, run 42506609035 (sum 42.3 min against a 43.7 min job; three objects hit the 600 s neofit2.x timeout). An object with no time failed at the fixture lookup and is priced at 0.01 min. setup_min is the measured image pull (34 to 85 s).

adam-core.source: MEASURED per object, scaled to the hosted runner: each object's OD child wall (run_od plus the child's own start) from one network-denied local run of the fixed channel over all 50 OD objects (adam-core 0.8.0 with adam-assist 0.7.0, the plan of run 42940569667, 8 objects at a time on a 16-core M-series Mac under outside load), times 1.577, the median hosted/local wall ratio over the 19 objects the hosted adam-core leg of run 42940569667 also fitted in 30 s or more locally (ratios 0.68 to 1.79; that leg reached 43 of 50 objects before its 150-minute timeout). Priced at the 30-minute per-object wall cap once scaled (none reached it locally; 67P took 20.6 min and 46P/Wirtanen 25.5): 67P, 46P/Wirtanen. setup_min is that leg's venv install (48 s), leg_overhead_min its kernel load and every propagation and ephemeris row of the catalog (38 s). Sum 148.0 min. Replace with the first hosted run's adam_core_wall_s per object.

adam-core-rust.source: MEASURED LOCALLY, not on a hosted runner: each object's OD child wall (run_od plus its own start: kernel load and ASSIST's data fingerprint) from one network-denied run of all 50 OD objects (adam_core 0.8.0 with adam_assist 0.7.0), 8 objects at a time on a 16-core M-series Mac, times 1.577, the median hosted/local wall ratio the Python channel's entry measures against the hosted adam-core leg of run 42940569667 (the two channels' local walls agree to about 5 percent in total), plus the object's propagation and ephemeris call time from a network-denied run of all 4830 rows. Priced at the 30-minute wall cap once scaled: 46P/Wirtanen, 67P (none reached the cap locally; 67P took 21.6 min and 46P/Wirtanen 26.9, a refused fit). setup_min is a cold cargo build at -j 4 (80 s locally with the crates already downloaded, about 3 minutes estimated on 4 vCPU, scaling by the 2.1 the earlier 2.8 to 6 minute estimate used; a tool-cache hit skips it); leg_overhead_min covers the leg's kernel load and data fingerprint (about 10 s measured) plus slack. Replace with the first hosted run's adam_core_rust_wall_s per object.
